_meta.purpose: Conformance golden fixture for one shipped connector (AC4). Locks the connector's per-concept conformance declaration (status/reason/mapper/field_gaps) from discovery/concepts/conformance.py. The CI gate (tests/contract/test_r2_0_b4_t5_conformance_fixtures.py) fails if a shipped connector has no fixture here, and pins each fixture to the registry so a conformance change cannot ship without updating its golden.
_meta.note: Every 'supported' concept's mapper must resolve in T2's mapper registry (discovery.concepts.mappers.resolve_mapper) — the gate checks it. The raw→concept correctness of each mapper is proven by T2's connector-mapping test.

actor_group.reason: a Slack channel is a group-shaped container mapped as group_type='team', NOT 'queue' — work is not routed to or drawn from it, and a queue-ageing detector reading it as a queue would report backlog that does not exist

approval.reason: the source has no approval concept — it records content/activity, not gated decisions

artifact.reason: a thread, keyed on the same thread artifact id the R18-A4 conversation model uses, so a concept and a retrieval chunk point at one artifact rather than two ids for one thread

field_gaps.reason: a conversation thread has no version; an edit re-renders the whole thread rather than producing a new revision (R18-A4's refresh model), so a revision number would be invented

assignment.reason: the source has no unit-of-work record; its signal is content or events, not tracked work

state_transition.reason: the source has no unit-of-work record; its signal is content or events, not tracked work
